ENH6: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?
Who is a Divine and who is a preacher?
GLR9: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||
Who is the house-holder and who the renouncer? Who can appraise the Lord's worth?
8648: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?
How is man bound and how is he delivered?
A5ZF: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?
In what way can he escape from coming and going?

Who is subject to actions and how is above actions? Who utters the Name of the Lord and causes others to utter it?
1H58: Who is happy, and who is sad?
Who is cheerful and who is afflicted?

Who is the one who turns towards the Guru and who is the one who turns away from the Guru?

By what means God is met? How is man separated from Him? This way who shall explain to me?
JU2Q: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?
What is the Divine Word by which the mind's wandering ceases?
CRF5: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?
What is that instruction by which man bears woe and weal alike?

What is that mode of life by which the mortal may meditate on the Supreme Lord? In what way can be sing the praises of God?
DUKK: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.
The Guruwards is emancipated and the Guruward is united with God.
4C9J: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.
Sikh resigns to the Guru's will is the knower, and the Sikh resigned to the Guru's will is the knower preacher.
JXHK: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||
Blessed is the Guru's believer, whether he is the house holder of the renouncer. The believer in the Guru knows the worth of the Lord.
K80D: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.
Through pride the man is bound and through the Guru he is freed.
3P16: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.
By the Guru's instruction his coming and going cease.
UVM1: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||
The Guruward does good deeds the Guruward is above actions and whatever the Guruward does, he does that in good faith.
9K49: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.
The believer in the Guru is happy and the mindward unhappy.
Z7CN: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.
The Guruward turns towards the Guru and the mindward turns away from the Guru.
QJ5U: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||
The Guruward is united with the Lord and the apostate is separated from Him. Through the Guru the way is revealed.
W68Q: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.
The Guru's instruction is the Divine word by which the wandering mind is controlled.
CRYB: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.
By the instruction of the Exalted Guru pain and pleasure are borne alike.
62G2: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||
The Guru's teachings is the way by which the Supreme Lord is meditated upon. The pious person sings the praises of God.
SJ5C: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.
The entire make the Lord Himself has made.
3M8R: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.
Everything He does causes to be done and establishes Himself.
WAU7: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||
From One the Lord has become numberless and the numberless, O Nanak! at last merge in the One Lord.
TUPQ: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?
When the Lord is imperishable, what uneasiness can there be then?
WFNE: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.
God is prosperous, so His slave is greatly at ease.
FC80: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||
You, O my Master! art the bestower of soul, life, honour and happiness. What You does from that I derive comfort.
QMBM: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.
I am a sacrifice, and my life is a sacrifice to the holy men to whose soul and body. You are pleasing.
BFE9: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||
You are my mountain you are my shelter. With You, O Lord! none can rival. Pause.
7YRH: That person, to whom Your actions seem sweet,
The person, to whom Yours doings taste sweet,
7CQE: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.
see the Supreme Lord among all the hearts.
JT68: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||
Within spaces and interspaces, You are, You are. You alone O unique Lord! art pervading everywhere.
LAHA: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.
You are the Fulfiller of all the heart's desires.
RVL9: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.
With devotion and affection are brimful Yours treasures.
W3VN: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||
They whom You mercifully protectest through perfect good fortune merge in You O Lord!

89CQ: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.
From the blind well you have dragged me out on the dry shore.
DE4V: Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.
By showing Your mercy You have seen Your servants with Yours gracious glance.
HXD2: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||
The servant sings the praise of the perfect and immortal Lord. By saying and hearing His praises exhaust not.
YUE7: Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.
Here and hereafter You are the Protector.
GH7U: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.
In mother's womb You cherishes the child.
UVBZ: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they sing His Glorious Praises. ||5||
The fire of mammon affects not those who are imbibed in the Lord's love and sing His praises.
1LF9: What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?
What excellences of Yours can I relate and remember?
6AW5: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.
Within my soul and body I behold you with my eyes.
VTSS: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||
You are my friend my intimate and my Lord. Without you I know not any other.
LF14: O God, that one, to whom You have given shelter,
He whose helper You have become, O Lord!
QJ2R: is not touched by the hot winds.
is not affected by even the hot wind.
5SMY: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||
You are the Lord our refuge and the giver of peace. By remembering You in the saints society You becomest manifest.
D3W3: You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.
You are lofty unfathomable infinite and invaluable.
9YCA: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.
You are the True Lord. I am Your servant and slave.
CPX6: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||8||3||37||
You are the King and True is Yours sovereignty. Nanak is devoted and a sacrifice to You.
82LC: Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.
For ever and aye do you remember the luminous Lord.
1AFR: Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||
Never forget Him in your mind. Pause.
NU4Z: Join the Society of the Saints,
Attain to the society of the saints,
LHVY: and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.
by which you shall not go down the way of death.
83AA: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||
Have the viaticum of God's Name. Thus no blemish shall attach to your lineage.
DSB7: Those who meditate on the Master
They, who meditate on the Master, are not thrown into the hell.
X2NW: shall not be thrown down into hell.
They, who meditate on the Master, are not thrown into the hell.
MV07: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||
Even the hot wind touches them not within whose mind the Lord has come and acquired an abode.
8R6X: They alone are beautiful and attractive,
Beauteous and good looking are they,
G9DN: who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
who dwell in the society of the saints.
1X5F: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep and thoughtful and vast. ||3||
Who have amassed the wealth of God's Name, they are sagacious and extremely exquisite.
TFHL: Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,
Drink you the Name Nectar, the home of happiness,
4A0Y: and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.
and live you by viewing the face of the Lord's slave.
1X2X: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||
Have all the affairs of Yours set aright by ever worshipping the feet of the Guru.
GEG9: He alone meditates on the Lord of the World,
Whom God has made His Own,
BTR2: Whom the Lord has made His Own.
he alone reflects on the World-Lord.
G866: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||
He is the warrior and he the chosen one on whose forehead good fortune is recorded.
RVU8: Within my mind, I meditate on God.
Within my mind I have meditated on the Master.
8QJZ: For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.
For me this is like enjoying the revelments of sovereignty.
US3N: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions. ||6||
Evil never originates in me. I am saved by being dedicated to the righteous action.
QQ0D: I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;
The Creator I have enshrined in my mind,
EF0Y: I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.
and I have obtained the fruit of life.
KNS0: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||
O bride if God the Spouse, becomes pleasing to your mind then shall your married life become ever stable.
NY64: I have obtained the eternal wealth of the Name,
RDAN: I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.
by seeking the shelter of the dispeller of fear.
BY00: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38||
Attaching to His skirt, the Lord has saved Nanak and he has won for himself the peerless life.
P18P: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the True Guru's grace He is obtained.
9RPV: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||
By pondering and reflecting over God the mind becomes steady. Pause.
AQJ8: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased and dispelled. ||1||
By remembering and thinking of the bright Guru dread is effaced and dispelled.
X46N: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2||
If the mortal seeks the refuge of the supreme Lord then why shall he repent again?

ZPQV: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||
By adoring the feet of the saints and the pious persons all the desires are fulfilled.
QW9D: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||
In all the hearts the unique Lord is contained. He is fully filling water, dry lands the earth and the sky.
EFDK: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||
Sanctified by the dust of the feet of the saints, I have served Lord, the destroyer of sins.
SXPJ: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||
The Master Himself has entirely delivered me and I am pacified by meditating on God.
RSPH: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||
The Creator had done justice and the evil-doers have died becoming mute and dumb.
NAVK: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||
Nanak is imbued with the True Name and he ever beholds God just before his eyes.
GAAM: Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:
X5Y2: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By the favour of the True Guru He is obtained.
A6YZ: Kirat = {कृति} deeds performed (Performance). Ke = according to. Ram = O Lord!
O Lord! According to the earnings of our own deeds we are parted (from you) (we have forgotten you); show mercy and unite us with yourself.
By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.
O Omnipresent Lord! show mercy and unite us with You who, on account of the deeds done, are separated from You.

Whatever evil deed (kirat) we have done before, according to that we are parted. O Guru! Show mercy and unite me with Ram. ☬ If the Guru should say that you first perform good deeds such as pilgrimage to the holy places, to that he says:
EKUZ: Kunt = koot, a side. Dahdis = the ten sides (north, west, south, east, the four corners, the upper side, the lower side). Sam = refuge.
(Caught in the attachment of Maya) we have gone on wandering all around on every side (for the sake of comforts); now, O Lord! Wearied, we have come to your refuge.
We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.
Weary of wandering in the four corners and ten directions we have come to Yours sanctuary, O Lord!

(Char kunt) the four corners — east, west, north, south — these are the chief ones among them, so we have wandered in all ten directions. O Lord! Wearied, we have come to your (sam) refuge. ☬ If the Guru should say, you have obtained a human birth, then why are you in sorrow? He shows the fruitlessness of the human birth without the singing of Parmesvar's praise:
1D0Y: (Just as) a cow empty of milk is of no use at all,
Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.
A cow without milk serves no purpose.
Just as a cow without milk is of no use at all.
5CJK: Sakh = the crop, the harvest. Dam = money, wealth.
(just as) without water the crop dries up (the harvest does not ripen, and out of that crop) no wealth can be earned, (so too without the Lord's Name our life goes for nothing).
Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.
Without water the crop withers and fetches not the price.
Again, just as (sakh) the crop withers without water and (dam) rupees are not produced — the meaning being that nothing is realised.
99YB: Nah = husband. Kat = how, where? Bisram = comfort. Jit = in which.
Without meeting the friend, the husband-Lord, comfort too is not found in any other place.
If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?
If we meet not God the Spouse our friend, how can we find rest?
In just this way, having obtained the human birth, when Hari the friend is not met, then (kat) where is (bisram) steadiness to be found?
538S: Jit ghar = in which (heart-)home. Bhath = a burning furnace. Se = like. Gram = a village.
(And how should comfort be found?) That heart-home in which the husband Lord does not come to dwell — for such a one the villages and cities (he lives in) are like a burning furnace.
Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.
Those houses, villages and towns where-in God the Husband becomes not manifest are like a furnace.

That (ghar) inner self in which Hari the husband has not become manifest — that town, that is, the body of kings and the rest, like a great settlement, and (gram) a village in which there are few houses, likewise the bodies of the destitute — all burn like a furnace, and peace does not come.
LYHM: Srab = all. Tambol = rolls of betel leaf. San = along with, together with. Dehi = the body. Kham = raw, perishable, useless.
(To a woman without her husband) all the adornments of the body, the rolls of betel leaf and the other relishes appear useless, together with (her) very body,
All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.
All decorations, betel and dainties along with the body are all in vain.

All the adornments, (tambol) betel leaf, and however many relishes there are, in attachment to which Parmesvar has been forgotten — together with (san dehi) the body, all are (kham) raw; the meaning being that they are perishable.
NAR4: Sabh = all. Jam = jam, the enemies of the soul.
(so too) without (the remembrance of) the master, the husband-Lord, all friends and companions come as enemies of the soul.
Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.
Without the Lord Master the Bride groom all the friends and intimates are like the death's myrmidon.

(Prabh) O Guru! Without the attaining of the master, the husband Parmesvar, those who make friendship, and again (sajan) the unfeigned benefactor who, having done a kindness, wants a return for it — all of them appear to me as (jam) the form of Yama; the meaning being that all are the cause of fear.
5VB3: (That is why) Nanak's supplication is that (O Lord!) show mercy and grant the gift of your own Name.
This is Nanak's prayer: "Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.
Nanak's supplication is "show yours benediction and grant Your Name".
Sri Guru ji says: this alone is my supplication — show mercy and give the Name.
QMED: O Hari! Keep (me) joined at your own feet, (all other supports and props are perishable) your house alone is the one that abides for ever. ||1||
O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence". ||1||
O God! the Lord master eternal is whose mansion, unite me with You.
O master! O Guru, unite me with Hari the Lord, whose (dham) light is unmoving. ||1|| Now the twelve months begin:
F2DQ: Chet = in the month of Chet. Ghana = much.

In Chet (the spring season comes, the flower-garden blossoming on every side gives delight to the mind; if) we remember the Lord (then by the grace of that remembrance) great spiritual bliss can come about.
In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.
By remembering the Master of the universe in the month of Chetar great rejoicing emanates.
By way of Chet he says: let us worship Govind, from which great bliss may come.
LAV8: Mil = having met. Rasna = the tongue. Bhana = utterance.
But the gift of repeating the Lord's Name with the tongue is obtained only by meeting the holy servants.
Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.
By meeting the pious persons, and uttering the Name with the tongue the Lord is obtained.
The (bhana) uttering of the Name with the tongue is obtained by meeting together with the holy servants.
DP1F: Jin = the person who. Tiseh = to him. Ae gana = consider him to have come.
Know that person alone to have been born into the world (know his birth alone to be fruitful) who has (with the help of remembrance) obtained union with his own Lord.
Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.
In this world the advent of only those is of account who have obtained their Lord.
He who has obtained his own Lord — his coming is reckoned fruitful; the meaning being that his birth is fruitful.
E0HU: (Because) without the remembrance of the Lord, know that even the passing of a moment's span means a life spent in vain.
Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.
Vain is deemed to be the life of him who live without Him even for a moment.
That one moment which is lived without him — by that, (jana) the birth of men goes in vain.
11PA: Maheeal = mahee tal, upon the surface of the earth, in the open space, in the sky.
That Lord who pervades everywhere — in the water, in the earth, in the sky, in the forests,
The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.
The Lord is fully filling water dry lands the earth and firmament and is contained in the forests too.
In water, land, earth and sky he is full, and again he pervades within the forests.
NDKU: if such a Lord does not come to dwell within some person's heart, then that person's (mental) suffering cannot be told.
Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!
How much pain shall I reckon to befall a person who remembers not that Lord?
Those to whom such a Lord does not come to mind — how much sorrow is reckoned to them? The meaning being that it is very great sorrow.
WHBB: (But) those people who have enshrined that (all-pervading) Lord within their own hearts, their great fortune awakens.
Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.
Very great is the fortune of those who repeat the Name of that Lord.

Those who have repeated that Lord, those persons have enjoyed bliss through (bhag mana) the highest fortune; or, their fortunes are supreme; or, their fortunes are by the maund — the meaning being that they are endless.
L3AH: Kanu = to. Mana = man, within the mind.
Nanak's mind (too) yearns for the sight of Hari; within Nanak's mind is the thirst for the sight of Hari.
My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!
For God's sight, O Nanak! my soul craves and my mind is thirsty.
Sri Guru ji says: the mind longs for the sight of Hari; again, within the mind is the longing for the sight; or, it is a longing by the maund, that is, a very great longing.
D84G: Tis kai pae = at that person's feet. Laga = laggan, I attach myself ||2||
The person who brings about my union with Hari, I shall fall at his feet. ||2||
I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||
I touch the feet of him who may unite me with that Master, in the month of Chetar.
By way of Chet he says: whoever unites me with that Lord, at his feet may I fall. ||2||
UKTF: Vaisakh = in Vaisakh. Kiau dheeran = how are they to keep patience? Vadheeaa = those parted from their husband. Bichhoh = separation. Prem bichhoh = the absence of love.

(The day of Vaisakhi is a day of longing for every woman and man, but) in Vaisakh how are the hearts of those women to hold steady who lie parted from their husband, within whom there is the absence of love (of its expression),
In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.
In the month of Waisakh how can the separated, who suffer separation from their Beloved have patience?
By way of Vaisakh he says: those (vadheeaa) parted from Parmesvar, whose love's (bichhoh) separation has come about — how are they to keep patience?
KRM6: Maia dhoh = Maya in the form of deceit, the mind-beguiling Maya.
(In this way how is patience to come to that being to whom), forsaking the friend-Lord, the mind-beguiling Maya has clung?
She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.
They forget Lord God the Friend, and are attached with the deceitful wealth.
Forsaking Hari the friend, the Purakh, the intellect has become attached to (dhoh) the Maya that is the form of deceit.
JG6S: Kaltr = the wife. Palach = having been caught, having become entangled. Sagli = the whole (creation).
Neither son, nor wife, nor wealth — none goes through with a person; the imperishable Lord alone is the true companion.
Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.
The son the wife and the riches go not with the mortal but that imperishable God does.
The son, again the wife, and likewise wealth — none of them keeps company with the being; (oh) that imperishable Hari is the one who becomes the helper.
97GK: Dhandhai moh = the attachment of worldly business.
The attachment of perishable business is afflicting (the whole world), and being caught in it again and again (in the attachment of Maya) the whole world is dying (a spiritual death).
Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.
Being entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations the whole world had perished.
Being attached to false dealings, the whole creation has been caught and caught again and has died.
72MU: Khoh laeeah = they are snatched away. Agai = beforehand.

Without the remembrance of the Name of the one Lord, however many other deeds are done here, all of them are snatched away even before death (that is, they cannot become a part of a high spiritual life).
Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.
Without the Name of One God, One had his future marred.
Without the Name of the one Hari, the other deeds done with desire are snatched away upon the road of Yama.
E7G5: Day = the beloved Lord. Vigchana = one is brought to ruin.
Forsaking the Lord who is the very form of love, there is nothing but ruin; without the Lord the soul has no other companion at all.
Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.
By forgetting God the mortal is ruined. Without the Lord there is no other.
(Day) forsaking Waheguru the prompter, one is brought to ruin, because without the Lord there is no other helper.
S4WB: Those people who attach themselves to the feet of the beloved Lord, their good glory (in this world and the next) comes about.
Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.
Pure is the fame of those who are attached to the feet of the Beloved.
Those who are attached to the feet of the beloved Waheguru, their glory is spotless. ☬ Now he shows the manner of making the supplication:

FLRK: Parapat hoe = {पर्याप्तं = to one's heart's content} that by which (my) heart's longing may be fulfilled.
O Lord! (At your door) my supplication is that I may be granted your heart-filling union.
Nanak makes this prayer to God: "Please, come and unite me with Yourself."
Nanak makes supplication before the Lord "Come and unite me with You, O Lord! "
Sri Guru ji says: O Lord! My supplication is that if you meet me, then my (para) beyond-all (pat) honour may come about.
7QJ5: Sant har = Hari the saint. Bhetai = may meet ||3||
(With the turning of the season all the vegetation around may become lovely, but) the month of Vaisakh can seem beautiful to the soul only if the saint-Lord Hari be met. ||3||
The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||
Only then does the month of Waisakh become beautiful when the saint causes man to meet that God.
O Hari! That saint of yours — when he is met, then alone does Vaisakh seem lovely. ||3||
F858: Jeth = in Jeth. Har jurranda loreeai = one ought to be joined at the Lord's feet. Sabh = all beings. Nivann = they bow.
That Hari before whom all beings bow their heads — in the month of Jeth one ought to be joined at his feet.
In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.
In the month of Jeth, man ought to unite with Him before whom all bow.
By way of the month of Jeth he says: the mind ought to be joined in Hari, before which Hari all become humble.
2AS3: Sajan davan = in the friend's skirt, in his lap. Kisai... bann = he does not let anyone bind, he does not give leave to any Yama and the rest to bind that being and drive him along.

If we remain attached to the hem of Hari the friend, then he does not give leave to any (Yama and the rest) to bind and drive us along (that is, being attached to the Lord's hem, the fear of the Yamas no longer remains).
One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.
None can keep him in bondage, who is attached to the skirt of God the Friend.
Being attached to the (davan) skirt of Hari the friend — that is, having come into his refuge — he does not give anyone up bound; that is, he is a hero of refuge.
4G4R: (People run about to gather precious wealth such as diamonds, pearls and rubies, but there remains the anxiety of that wealth being stolen) the Lord's Name is such precious wealth, of diamonds and pearls, that it cannot be stolen.
God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.
The Lord's Name is like gems and pearls. Them none can burgle and steal.
The pearl and the gem, that is, the Name of the Lord who is the form of all riches — to that wealth which is those qualities no (sannh) breach is made; the meaning being that it is not stolen.
MT7H: Rang jete = however many colours there are. Narainai = of the Lord. Bhavann = they seem dear.
However many of the Lord's wonders are taking place, (by the grace of the Name-wealth) all of them seem dear within the mind.
In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.
In the Primal Being are all the delights which fascinate the mind.
However many colours seem pleasing within the minds of beings, all are Narayan's; the meaning being that by singing Parmesvar's praise all of them come to be within bliss itself.
6WAJ: (This understanding also comes, that) the Lord himself and the beings he has created do only that which is pleasing to that Lord.
As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.
What God desires, He does that. That very thing the creatures do.
Whatever Hari wishes to have done, that alone is the deed the beings do.
BPBC: Prabh = the Lord. Kaheeah = they are called.
Those people whom the Lord has made his own (by giving the gift of his praise), they alone receive applause (in the world).
They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.
They whom the Lord has made His own are said to be praise worthy.
Those persons whom the Lord has made his own servants are called worthy of praise.
BFLC: Vichhurr = having been parted from the Lord.
(But the Lord cannot be found by the beings' own effort) if he could be found by the beings' own effort, then why would beings be in sorrow at being parted from him?
If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?
By their own obtainment, If men could meet the Lord, why should they then weep in separation?
If Hari were to be met by one's own taking, then why would beings weep at being parted from Parmesvar? ☬ Question: how is Hari to be attained? To that he says:
RBDY: Sadhu sang = the company of the Guru.
O Nanak! Those beings alone enjoy the bliss (of union with the Lord) who obtain the company of the Guru.
Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.
Meeting God through the society of the saints, O Nanak! the pious persons enjoy celestial bliss.
Sri Guru ji says: those who have had the company of the saints, they, having attained Hari, enjoy bliss.
4UL0: Tis = to that (person). Jis kai mathann = upon whose forehead ||4||
That person upon whose forehead fortune awakens, to him the month of Jeth seems lovely, and to him alone the master-Lord is found. ||4||
In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||
In Jeth, the playful Lord Master meets Him, on whose forehead good fortune is recorded.
By way of the month of Jeth he says: Hari the master, (rangeela) the blissful one, is attained by that one upon whose forehead the highest fortunes are.
HLZG: The month of Har seems burning to that being (those people go on burning and lamenting like the month of Har) within whose heart the husband-Lord does not dwell,
The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.
The month of Har, seems hot for them to whom God Spouse is not near.
Those beside whom Hari the (nah) husband is not — that is, is not attained — to them Har seems as though it burns.
6QDD: Jag jeevan purakh = the Lord who is the support of the world. Sandee = of.
who, forsaking (the support of) the Lord who is the life of the world, keep up their hopes in people.
They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.
They forsake God the life of the world and rely upon man's hope.
Those who, forsaking the Purakh who is the life of the world, place their hope in man.
2UUL: Duyai bhae = in the love of some other (than the Lord). Vigucheeai = one is brought to ruin. Gal = about the neck.
Living on the support of anyone other (than the Lord) there is nothing but ruin; (whoever looks to any other support) about his neck falls the noose of Yama (his life passes for ever in dread).
In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.
Through another's love the man is ruined and round his neck wears the death's halter.
They are ruined through the sense of duality; and again, know the noose of Yama to have fallen about their necks.
BUJU: Lunai = he reaps. Mathai = upon the forehead.
(The law of nature is just this, that) whatever seed a person sows, and whatever writ is written upon his forehead (according to the deeds done), such is the fruit he obtains.
As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.
Whatever is recorded on man's brow and what he shows that does he reap.
Whatever deed he does, such will he suffer; whatever writ is written upon the forehead, that he now does.
FJNV: Rain = the night, the life. Niras = one of a broken heart.
(The soul-bride who forgets the Purakh who is the life of the world) passes her whole life in nothing but regrets; she departs from the world with a broken heart.
The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.
When the night of human life passes away the man repents and departs without hope.
When (rain) the life has gone, then the woman who is the soul, making her repentance, becoming hopeless, rises up and goes.
VS9V: Kau = to. Bheteeai = is met. Sadhu = the Guru. Khalas = with an unclouded face, worthy of honour.
Those people who meet the Guru are honoured in the presence of the Lord (they receive honour and regard).
Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.
They, who meet the saints, are exonerated in God's Court.
Those who have met the saints have become free of bonds in the court. ☬ Therefore let us make our supplication thus:
BY7Z: Prabh = O Lord! Hoe = may remain.
O Lord! Nanak's supplication (before you) is — show your mercy, may the longing for your sight remain (within my mind),
Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
Show Your mercy to me, O Lord! that I may thirst for a sight of You.
O Lord! Show such mercy of your own by which there may be the longing for your sight alone.
ZFQU: (Because) O Lord! Apart from you I have no other support or prop at all.
Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.
Nanak makes a supplications, "Beside You, O Lord! there is not any other".
O Lord! Apart from you there is no other second; Sri Guru ji says: my supplication is before you alone — the meaning being, grant the sight.
QCN1: That person within whose mind the dwelling of the Lord's feet is kept, to him even (the burning) Har seems lovely (the sorrows and afflictions of the world too cannot make him suffer). ||5||
The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||
Har is pleasant for him, in whose heart abide God's feet.
O Hari! He within whose mind is the (nivas) dwelling — that is, the meditation — upon your feet, to him Har seems good, the meaning being that it is fruitful. ||5||
03EU: Savan = in Savan. Sarsi = sa-rasi, full of sap, made green. Kamani = the soul-bride.
Just as in Savan (the vegetation becomes green with the rain, so too that) soul-bride becomes green (that is, that being's heart blossoms) whose love comes to be with the Lord's beautiful feet.
In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
In the month of Sawan, happy is the bride who enshrines love for the Lord's lotus feet.
By way of Savan he says: the woman who is the soul and who makes love with the lotus feet, she has attained (sarsi) abundance, or bliss.
WLGQ: Sach rang = in the love of the True One. Adhar = the support.
Her mind and her body become dyed in the love of the Lord; the Lord's Name alone becomes the support (of her life).
Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.
Her mind and body are imbued with the love of the True One and God's Name is her only support.
Those who have made the support of the one Name alone, their mind and body are dyed in the true love.
BL6Z: Bikhia rang = the colours of Maya. Disan = they appear. Chhar = ashes.
The perishable wonders of Maya all appear to her as ashes (as worthless).
The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.
The sinful pleasures are false. All that is apparent, turns to ashes.
The colours of the sense-objects all appear false and perishable.
KR28: Sadhu = the Guru. Peevanhar = fit to drink.

(As in Savan the raindrop seems lovely, so to the person who loves the Lord's feet) the drop of the Lord's Name, which gives spiritual life, seems dear; meeting the Guru, that person becomes fit to drink that drop (even the smallest matters of the Lord's greatness seem sweet to him; meeting the Guru he listens with great eagerness).
The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.
Beauteous are the drops of God's Nectar. By meeting the Saint-Guru one quaffs them.
Lovely is the nectar drop of Hari's Name, but it is by meeting the saints that one becomes fit to drink it.
6K9Z: Tin = grass. Maulia = green and flourishing.
That Lord by whose union the whole world (the vegetation and the rest) is green and flourishing, that Lord who is able to do all things, who is all-pervading and boundless,
The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.
The forests and grass blades are refreshed with the love of the omnipotent, all-pervading and infinite Lord.
By the power of the Lord, the boundless and all-capable Purakh, the woods and the grass are (maulia) blossoming.
EKZ4: my mind too yearns to meet him, but that Lord himself, by his own mercy, is able to bring about the meeting.
My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!
To meet God, my mind yearns through His grace He is met.
The minds of many people long for the meeting with Hari, but it is good deeds that bring about the meeting.
WZMF: I am a sacrifice, ever devoted, to those Gurmukh companions who have obtained union with the Lord.
Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.
The fellow-maids who have obtained the Lord; to them I am ever a sacrifice.
Those companions who are the saints and who have obtained the Lord — to them I go for ever as a sacrifice.
2Y23: Maia = mercy. Sabad = through the shabad.
O Nanak! (Make your supplication and say —) O Lord! Show mercy upon me; you yourself alone are able to make (my soul) beautiful through the Guru's shabad.
O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.
Nanak, when venerable God shows mercy He bedecks the mortal with His Name.
Sri Guru ji says: Hari, showing mercy upon the beings, is the one who makes them pure through the Guru's shabad.
9E3V: The month of Savan is (the bringer of blossoming and coolness) for those fortunate (soul-brides) who have put upon their heart (as upon the neck) the garland of the Lord's Name. ||6||
Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||
Sawan is delightful for those happy wives whose mind is bedecked with the necklace of the Name of the pervading God.
Savan is plainly fruitful for those blessed ones who have borne within the heart the garland of the Name of Ram. ||6||
5GSV: Bhadue = in the month of Bhadon. Bharam = in wandering. Bhulania = she goes astray. Het = affection, love.

(Just as) in Bhadon (with its glare and its whirling heat a person is greatly distressed, so too) that soul-bride whose love is joined to some other than the husband-Lord goes astray, because of her wandering, from the right road of life.
In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.
In Bhadon she, who cherishes love for another is lost in doubt.
By way of the month of Bhadon he says: those women who are souls and who have gone astray through delusion, their love is attached to duality.
2DPU: Though she make lakhs of adornments, they come to no use of hers at all.
She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.
Though she may make lakhs of decorations but they are not of any avail.
Although (lakh) she has made very many adornments of good qualities, still they are of no use — the meaning being that where there is affection for relations, they are in vain.
F1NE: Jit = in which. Din = in the day. Deh = the body. Kahasan = they will say. Binsasee = it will perish. Pret = one who has passed on, unclean.
On the day when a person's body perishes (when a person dies), at that time (all the relations and kin) will say that he has now passed away. (The corpse lies unclean, take it out quickly.)
On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.
The day the body perishes at that time people call him a ghost.
On the day when the body (binsasee) came to nothing, at that very time they will call him a pret — the meaning being that 'pret' is the name given to a corpse.
DJJX: Pakarr = having seized. Na deni = they do not give, na den.
The messengers of Yama seize (the soul) and drive it before them; they tell the secret to no one (of where they are taking it).
The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.
The couriers of death seize and dispatch the soul and acquaint none with the secret.
The messengers of Yama will seize those of evil deeds and drive them to the city of Yama; they will give the secret to no one.
2UN1: (Those relations) with whom (all one's life) so great a love was kept, they abandon one's company in a moment.
And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.
They, with whom man is in love leave him in an instant and stand aside.
Those relations with whom love was joined will, in a single moment, forsake their attachment and stand apart.
Y4TM: Kape = it is cut. Siahahu = from black (in colour). Set = white.
(Seeing death come, a person) greatly repents, his body is in distress, he turns from black to white (with terror one colour comes and another goes).
She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.
He wrings his hands (tantalises) his body reels in pain and changes from black to white.

The being will wring his hands, the body will (kape) tremble with the fear of Yama; or, they cut the body with swords and the rest — (kapai) the colour becomes black, and again with fear it becomes white.
9N2V: Loonai = he reaps. Khet = the field. Sandarra = of.
This body is the field of a person's own deeds; whatever he sows in it, that very crop he reaps (whatever deeds he does, such fruit he obtains).
As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.
As the man sows so does he reap. Such is the field of actions.
Whatever deed he does, such fruit he enjoys; this body is the field of deeds.
NENA: O Nanak! Those whose protector and well-wisher the Guru becomes, the Guru puts them (aboard) the ship that is the Lord's feet
Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.
Nanak has sought the Lord's protection. The Master has given him the boat of His feet to cross the world-ocean.
Sri Guru ji says: those who have attained the refuge of the Lord, to them that Lord gives the ship that is his feet.
U5F4: Na paeeah = they are not cast. Het = a well-wisher, one who loves ||7||
and they are not cast into hell, (because by the Guru's grace) they come into the Lord's refuge. ||7||
Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||
They, who enshrine affection for the Guru, the saviour, are not consigned to hell in the month of Bhadon.
By way of Bhadon he says: those whose love the Guru is the keeper of, they are not cast into hell. ||7||
WRNB: Asun = in Asu. Umaharra = a surge. Jae = having gone. Kiau = how? In some way or other.

O mother! (After the whirling heat and glare of Bhadon have passed) in Asu (with its sweet season) a surge of love (for the husband-Lord) is rising (within me) (the mind writhes that) in some way or other I may go and meet the husband-Lord.
In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?
In Assu the Lord's love is over-flowing from within me. How shall I go and meet God?
By way of Asu he says: a surge of love has arisen, that going into the sangat — O Hari! How may I meet you?

D1BD: Man = within the mind. Tan = within the body. Ghani = great. An = having brought. Mae = O mother!
Within my mind and within my body a great thirst for the Lord's sight has arisen (the heart longs that) someone might bring (that husband) and bring about the meeting.
My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.
Within my mind and body is the great thirst for the Lord's sight. Let some one come and cause me to meet Him, O mother!
O (mae) holy servants! Within mind and body is a great longing for the sight; let someone (an) bring him and unite us.
3XDR: Hau = I! Tin kai pae = at their feet.
(Hearing that) the holy servants give help in increasing love, I have fallen at their feet.
The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.
The saints are my helpers in my love march. I fall at their feet.
Those holy servants who are the helpers of love, at their feet do I fall.
U5EU: (O mother!) Without the Lord comfort and bliss cannot be found (because for comfort and bliss) there is no other place at all.
Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.
Without the Lord how can peace be obtained? There is no place besides.
Without Parmesvar how are we to find comfort, because without him there is no other place at all that gives comfort.
0KC7: Ras = the taste, the bliss. Rahe aghae = they became satisfied, thirst cannot touch them.
Those (great-fortuned ones) who have tasted (even once) the savour of the Lord's love (forget the savours of Maya, and) they become satisfied (as regards Maya),
Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.
They, who have tasted the ambrosia of love, remain sated and satiated.
Those who have tasted the savour of love have become satisfied with the things of this world and the next.
EG0U: Ap = the sense of self. Larr = in the hem, in the lap.
forsaking the sense of self they go on making their supplications for ever — O Lord! Keep us attached to your own hem.
They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, "God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe."
Stilling their self-conceit, they make the supplication, O Lord, attach us to Yours skirt".
Having slain their pride, they make their supplication thus: O Lord, attach me to your own hem.
0C6E: Kant = the husband. Kateh = to any other place.
That soul-bride whom the Lord her husband has united with himself does not, being parted (from that union), go to any other place,
Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.
They, whom God the Spouse, has united with Himself, neither separate nor go anywhere else.
Those whom Hari the husband has united with himself do not go parted anywhere.
KC56: (because) O Nanak (she becomes certain that for lasting comfort) there is no place other than the Lord's refuge.
Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.
Without the Lord there is no other second. Nanak has entered God's sanctuary.
Sri Guru ji says: apart from the Lord there is no other, and therefore I have taken Hari's refuge.
0HX7: She remains ever in the Lord's refuge. In Asu (with its sweet season) those soul-brides dwell in comfort upon whom the Lord's grace is. ||8||
In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||
In Assu they, on whom is the grace of God the King dwell in peace.
Those upon whom the mercy of Hari the king is, they dwell in comfort in Asu. ||8||
VUHU: Katak = in Katak (with its cool bloom). Kahu jog = to anyone's account, upon anyone's forehead.
In Katak (with its lovely season) too (if the parting from the husband-Lord remained, then this) is the result of (one's own) deeds done; no blame can be laid upon anyone else's forehead.
In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.
In Katak do you Good deeds. It is not advisable to impute blame to any other.
By way of Katak he says: as the being performs his deeds, so does he enjoy the fruit; it is not fit to lay the blame upon anyone.
MPV5: Having strayed from (the remembrance of) Parmesar, all the sorrows and afflictions (of the world) take hold.
Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.
By forgetting the supreme Lord, all the ailments cling to the man.
To those who have strayed from Parmesvar, all diseases come and cling.
23QN: Ram te = from God. Lagan = they come to be. Janam vijog = the partings of births, long partings.
Those who have (in this birth) turned their faces from the remembrance of the Lord, upon them (then) long partings fall.
Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.
The non-believers in the Omnipresent Lord suffer separation from Him, birth after birth.
Those who have turned away from Ram, to them come the sorrows of parting through birth.
H352: Maia bhog = the enjoyments of Maya, the pleasures of the world.
Those enjoyments of Maya (for the sake of which the Lord had been forgotten, they too) become painful in a moment,
In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.
In an instant all the pleasures of wealth become bitter.
However many enjoyments of Maya he counted as sweet, those became (kaurre) painful in a moment at the hour of the end.
AH4J: Vich = the office of a go-between. Kis thai = before (any other) whom? Roj = daily, every day.

(In that sorrowful state) there is no use at all in weeping one's daily laments before anyone, (because the sorrow is on account of the parting, and to remove the parting) no one can act as a go-between.
No one can then serve as your intermediary. To whom can we turn and cry?
For them none can play the role of an intermediary. Before whom shall they daily bewail?
And in the meeting (vich na) no one can act as a go-between; before whom shall we weep (roj) always, or weep our weeping?
LBRD: Keeta = one's own doing. Dhur = from the very beginning, from the Lord's presence.
(The suffering being's own) efforts do not prevail; (according to the deeds done before) the manner of the writ written from the very beginning comes to pass.
By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.
Nothing can be done by man's doing. In the very beginning the destiny was recorded.
Nothing comes of one's own doing; union and parting have been taken from the very beginning.
9XR7: Sabh = all. Biog = the sorrows of parting.
(Yes!) If by good fortune the Lord (himself) comes and meets one, then all the sorrows born of parting are wiped away.
By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.
Through the greatest good luck my Lord is met. Then do all the pangs of separation depart.
When by great fortune my Lord is met, then the sorrows of parting are wiped away. ☬ Therefore let him make his supplication thus:
81A1: Kau = to. Prabhu = O Lord! Bandi moch = O you who release from prison!
(Nanak's supplication is just this —) O my master who releases from the bonds of Maya! Save Nanak (from the attachment of Maya).
Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.
Do You protect Nanak, O my Lord Master, the fetter cutter.
Sri Guru ji says: O Lord, O Sahib! Cut the (bandi moch) fetters that are the desires and keep me.
CC0S: Binsah = they are destroyed. Soch = anxiety ||9||
In Katak (with its delightful season) those who obtain the company of the holy, all their anxieties and cares (of parting) come to an end. ||9||
In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||
In Katik by obtaining the society of the saints all the anxieties of the mortal depart.
By way of Katak he says: when the company of the saints comes about, all anxiety is destroyed. ||9||
3495: Manghir = in Manghar. Mah = in the month. Pir sang = with the husband.
In the (cool and sweet) month of Maghar those soul-brides seem lovely who are seated with Hari their husband.
In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.
In Maghar beautiful are they who sit with their Beloved God.
By way of the month of Maghar he says: those who are seated with Hari the husband Waheguru — that is, who sing his praise — they are the resplendent ones.
HTHQ: Kia gani = what shall I tell? It cannot be described. Ji = whom. Sahib = the Sahib.
Those whom the master-Lord has united with himself, their glory cannot be described.
How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.
How can their glory be measured whom the Lord blends with Himself?
Those whom the Sahib has united — what reckoning is there of their glory?
F9VM: Ram sio = with the Lord. Sadh saheleeah sang = with the companions of the sangat.
In the company of the companions of the sangat, (joining their hearts) with the Lord, their bodies and their minds remain ever in bloom.
Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.
The body and mind of those who have the companionship of saints bloom with the Pervading God.
Those who have the company of the companions who are the saints, their body and mind are mingled with Ram, or are made green — the meaning being that they perform devotion.
1S1G: But those soul-brides who remain deprived (of the company) of the companions of the sangat, they remain alone (abandoned) (as a burnt sesame plant stands husbandless in the field).
Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.
They, who are without the society of the pious persons, dwell all alone.
Those who are (bahri) destitute of the company of the saints, they remain alone, without a husband.
4VDM: (Seeing the lone and husbandless soul, many enemies such as lust come and surround her, and) their suffering (born of the vices) never lifts; they remain fallen under the sway of the Yamas.
Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.
Their pain never departs and they fall under the clutches of the death's minister.
Therefore their suffering is never removed; they have fallen under the sway of Yama.
VF2R: Disah = they appear. Kharreeah = alert, watchful.
Those soul-brides who have enjoyed the company of the husband-Lord, they appear ever watchful (against the assault of the vices) (the vices cannot strike them, because)
Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.
They, who have enjoyed their Lord, are ever seen standing in His service.
And those who, knowing the Lord as their own, have enjoyed him, they are seen ever (kharreeah) alert in his praise.
MHG8: Kanth = about the neck (that is, within the heart).
the Lord's praises remain strung within their hearts, as diamonds, jewels and rubies are worn about the neck.
They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.
Their neck is set with the jewels, emeralds and rubies of God's Name.
Their (ratan) detachment and (javehar) direct realisation, and again (lal) love, are within the inner self, and the Name that is the gold thread is set about the neck.
ZXXB: Banchhai = he begs. Dar = at the door.
Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those companions of the sangat who lie at the Lord's door, who remain in the Lord's refuge.
Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.
Nanak desires the dust of the feet of those who fall for shelter at the Lord's door.
Sri Guru ji says: those who have gone to the Lord's door and fallen into his refuge, I long for their dust.
11RA: By remembering the Lord in Maghar the round of birth and death does not come again. ||10||
Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||
They, who meditate on the Master in the month of Maghar are not born again.
By way of Manghir he says: those who have worshipped the Lord, to them birth does not come again. ||10||
2KFY: Pokh = in the month of Poh. Tukhar = frost, hoar-frost. Na viapaee = it does not take hold. Kanth = about the neck, at the neck (within the heart). Nah = nath, the master, the husband.
In the month of Poh, that soul-bride at whose neck (within whose heart) the husband-Lord is clasped — upon her the frost (the hardness and coldness of the mind) cannot take hold,
In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.
In Poh cold affects not those whom God the Husband, hugs to His bosom.
By way of the month of Poh he says: to them the (tukhar) snow, that is, the cold that is inertness, does not take hold, at whose neck Hari the husband has been met.
PTK9: Bedhia = it is pierced. Charnarbind = charan-arbind, the lotus feet. Darsan = in the sight. Sahu = each single breath, the disposition.
(because) her disposition remains joined to the longing for the Lord's sight, and her mind remains pierced through in the Lord's beautiful feet.
Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
They, whose soul is pierced through with His lotus feet, remain attached to the Sovereign's sight.
Those whose mind has met with the lotus feet of Hari, to them (darsan lagarra sahu) the sight of Parmesvar has been attained — the meaning being that direct realisation has come about.
QL81: That soul-bride who has taken the support of Gobind and Gopal, she has earned the profit of the service of the husband-Lord,
Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.
Seek the protection of the King God, who is the Master of the world and the cherisher of the universe. The Lord's service is profitable.
O Govind, Gopal, king! I have taken your support; and again, they take the profit of the master's service.
VQ2Z: Bikhia = Maya. Sadhu = the Guru. Gun gah = reflection upon the qualities, a plunge into the qualities.
Maya cannot touch her; meeting the Guru she has plunged into the Lord's praise.
Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.
On meeting the saints sing the praises of the Lord and sin shall not be able to touch you.
Those who, meeting in the sangat, sing his qualities — the desire for the sense-objects cannot touch them.
YPJ4: Jah te = from which Lord. Samah = absorption.
That Lord from whom she took birth, in that very one she remains joined; her absorption remains fixed in the Lord's love.
From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.
Being absorbed in the True Love the soul gets blended with what it has sprung from.

That Parmesvar from whom the woman who is the soul had come forth — that is, from whom she had become separate — into that very one she has merged, and therefore through true love (samah) bliss has come about.
EFSN: Kar = the hand. Gah = having seized. Parbrahm = Parbrahm.
Parbrahm has seized (her) hand and joined (her to his own feet); she is not parted again (from his feet).
When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.
She, whom the Supreme Lord has grasped by hand separates not again.
That woman who is the soul, whom Parbrahm has seized by the hand that is the mind, she does not become separate again.
0RKD: Bar jau = I go as a sacrifice. Bereea = times. Agam = unapproachable. Agah = agadh, of a deep heart.
(But) that friend-Lord is very unapproachable, very deep; I am a sacrifice to him a hundred thousand times.
I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.
A hundred thousand times I am a sacrifice to God the unapproachable and unfathomable friend.
Hari the friend is unapproachable and (agah) unfathomable, but I go as a sacrifice to him a hundred thousand times.
FUDH: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.
Nanak has fallen at the Primal Being's door, and He had to preserve the honour of one lying at His door.
Q3GR: Sohanda = {the real word is 'sohanda', the reading is to be 'suhanda'. With the letter 's' both the vowels (o) and (u) have been used} it seems lovely ||11||
That one upon whom that carefree Lord shows mercy, to him the month of Poh seems lovely and all comforts come to him. ||11||
Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||
Poh is beauteous and the giver of all peace to him whom the Care-free Lord grants pardon.
In Poh, to that person there is loveliness and all comfort whom the (veparvah) desireless Parmesvar forgives. ||11||
JTQX: Magh = the month of the full moon in the Magha nakshatra. Magh = in the month of Magh. {Note: the first day of this month is, according to the Hindu shastras, very holy; Hindus consider bathing at the pilgrimage place of Prayag on the day of Maghi to be a very meritorious act}. Majan = a plunge.

In Magh (on the day of Maghi people consider bathing at pilgrimage places such as Prayag to be a great merit, but you, O brother!) sit in the company of the Gurmukhs — this alone is the bathing at the pilgrimage places — bathe in the dust of their feet.
In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
In Magh deem the bath in the dust of the saints' congregation as an ablution at shrines.
The fruit of bathing at Prayag and the other holy places in the month of Magh belongs to those who bathe in the dust of the saints.
63NK: Dan = the gift of the Name.
(With a spirit of humility keep the company of the Gurmukhs; there) repeat the Lord's Name, listen to the Lord's praise, and distribute this gift of the Name to all others,
Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.
Remember and hear God's Name and bestow it as alms to all.
Meditate upon the Name of Hari, and again listen to it, and give it in charity to all.
W62X: Janam karam mal = the filth of the vices born of the deeds done in many births. Guman = pride.
(In this way) the filth of the vices born of the deeds done in many births will come off (from your mind), and pride will be removed from within your mind.
In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.
So shall your filth of evil actions of many births be removed and pride vanish from your heart.
By that, pride will depart from the mind, and the filth of the deeds of many births will come off.

NACX: Kam = in lust. Karodh = in anger. Moheeai = one is beguiled. Suan = a dog.
(By the grace of remembrance) one is not caught in lust and anger, and the dog of greed too comes to an end (greed, under whose influence a person wanders from door to door like a dog).
Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.
Lust and wrath shall not seduce you and the dog of greed shall be destroyed.
One is not beguiled by lust and anger, and again the dog that is greed dies.
CCAN: Marag = upon the road. Ustat = glory.
Walking upon this true road, the world sings one's praise.
Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.
The world praises those who walk along the true way.
The world sings the praise of those who walk upon the true road.
Y02Z: Athsath = sixty-eight. Parvan = an accepted (religious act).
The bathing at the sixty-eight pilgrimage places, all meritorious deeds, and showing compassion to living beings, which is counted a religious act (all this comes within remembrance itself).
Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.
To take pity on the sentient beings is more acceptable than bathing at sixty-eight places of pilgrimage and giving all alms.
It is (parvan) the equal of bathing at the sixty-eight holy places and of all merits, to show compassion to living beings, or to one's own soul.
RUG5: That person to whom the Lord, showing mercy, gives (the gift of remembrance), that person becomes wise (one who recognises the right road of life).
That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.
He, on whom God mercifully bestows this virtue is a wise man.
That person to whom Waheguru, showing mercy, gives his own Name — he alone is the clever one.
44ND: O Nanak! (Say —) those to whom the beloved Lord has come, I am a sacrifice to them.
Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.
Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have met their Lord.
Sri Guru ji says: those to whom Hari their own master has come, upon them I go as a sacrifice.
FBTN: In the month of Magh only those people are called pure upon whom the perfect Satguru is merciful (and to whom he gives the gift of remembrance). ||12||
In Maagh, they alone are known as true, to whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful. ||12||
In Magh they to whom the perfect Guru is merciful are called the pure.
Those upon whom the perfect Guru has become merciful, they alone are called pure in Magh. ||12||
6QBR: Phalgun = in (the month of) Phagan. Uparjana = arising, manifestation.

(After the hard cold of the winter season, when spring turns, in the month of Phagan people make merry with the colours and revels of Holi, but) in Phagan spiritual bliss arises (within those soul-brides) within whose hearts the friend-Hari comes visibly to dwell.
In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, to whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.
In Phagan they alone obtain happiness to whom God the Friend has become manifest.
In Phagan bliss has (uparjana) arisen for those to whom Hari the friend has come and become manifest.
L4TH: Ram ke sahaee = those who give help in meeting the Lord.
The holy servants who give help in meeting the Lord, showing mercy, join them to the Lord.
The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.
The saints who render man assistance with the Pervading Lord, have mercifully united me with Him.
But when the saints who are the beloved of Ram became the helpers, then they, showing mercy, brought about the union.
DWWX: Sej = the heart. Jae = a place.
Their heart-bed becomes beautiful, all comforts come to them, and then for sorrows there remains no place at all (within their hearts).
My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.
My couch is beautiful, I possess all the comforts and now there is no room for aches.
By the coming of all comfort, that is, the comfort of the self, the bed that is the inner self has become resplendent; (hun) now there remains no place for sorrows.
ZMP0: Var = the husband-Lord. Gavahee = gavah, they sing.
The heart's desire of those great-fortuned soul-brides is fulfilled; they find Hari the Lord as their husband.
My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.
My desire has been fulfilled and I am exceedingly lucky in having God the monarch, as my Spouse.
Those who have obtained Hari the king as their husband, the whole desire of those great-fortuned ones has been fulfilled.
7T06: Mangal = a song of joy, a song that produces spiritual bliss, the bani of praise. Alae = having uttered, having sung out.
Joining with the companions of the sangat, singing out the songs of Gobind's praise, they sing the Gurbani that produces spiritual bliss.
Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.
Meeting together my fellow maids sing songs of rejoicing and utter the sermons of the world-Lord.
Those companions who are the holy servants and who sing his qualities — joining together with them, may I utter the songs of joy of Govind.
73UX: Disdi = appears. Lavai = near. Lavai launne = nearby, round about. Lavai na lae = not nearby, not able to make comparison.
Any other like the Lord, any second able to equal him, does not appear to them anywhere at all.
There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.
Like God I perceive no other. No one else is equal to Him.
To them no other appears like Hari; therefore no second is set as his equal or beside him.
1N4L: Halat = {अत्र} this world. Palat = {परत्र} the next world. Savarion = he (the Lord) has made it beautiful. Diteean = he (the Lord) has given. Jae = a place.
That Lord has made beautiful (for the companions of the sangat) both this world and the next; he has given them such a place (of absorption in his own feet) as never wavers at all.
He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanent home there.
He has embellished my this world and the next one, and had given me a permanent place.
The lives of those persons in this world and the next have been made beautiful, and an unmoving place has been given.
TNW4: Te = from. Rakhian = he (Hari) kept them. Dhae = dhaee, wandering.
The Lord has kept them (by giving his hand) from the world-ocean; their running about in the round of births does not happen again.
He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle of reincarnation.
He has rescued me from the world-ocean and I shall not again have to run through births.
He has kept them from the ocean of the world, and again they are not born, and (dhae) they do not run, that is, they do not die.
6RF8: O Nanak! (Say —) our tongue is one, and the Lord's qualities are countless (we are not fit to describe them, but) those beings who fall at his feet (who look to his support) cross over (the world-ocean).
I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak is saved, falling at Your Feet.
I have but one tongue and manifold are Yours excellences. Nanak is saved by falling at yours feet.
Sri Guru ji says: the tongue is one and the qualities of Waheguru are countless; those beings whom Hari has put at his own feet, they have crossed over.
P5V2: Til = even a little. Tamae = tamha, greed ||13||

In the month of Phagan (instead of seeking bliss in Holi and the rest) one ought ever to sing the praise of that Lord who has not even the least greed (for having his own greatness sung) (in this is our own good). ||13||
In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||
In Phagan ever praise Him who has not ever an iota of avarice.
By way of Phagan he says: let us praise him day by day in Phagan, who has not even a sesame-seed's worth of (tamae) desire. ||13||
9385: Jin = the person who. Sare = they are brought to completion.
Whichever person has repeated the Lord's Name, all their works are brought to fulfilment.
Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.
The affairs of those who have meditated on the Name have been adjusted.
Those persons who have meditated upon the Name, their works have become complete.
Z45F: Dargah sach = in the presence of the ever-abiding Lord. Khare = honoured.
Those who have worshipped the Lord and the perfect Guru, they are honoured in the presence of the ever-abiding Lord.
Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.
They, who contemplate over God-incarnate perfect Guru, are judged as true and genuine in His court.
Those who, (sach) with certainty, have worshipped the perfect Guru, those persons have been found true in the court of Hari.
L35A: Nidh = a treasure. Bhaujal = the world-ocean. Bikham = difficult.
The Lord's feet alone are the treasure of all comforts; (those beings who attach themselves to his feet) cross over (safe and sound) the difficult world-ocean.
The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.
God's feet are the treasure of all the comforts. Through them man crosses the dreadful and arduous world-ocean.
Obtaining the feet of Hari, the treasure of all comforts, they have crossed over the hard ocean of the world.
V8DD: Tin = those (people). Bikhia = Maya. Jare = they burn.
They obtain the Lord's love and the Lord's devotion; they do not burn in the fire of the craving of Maya.
They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.
They obtain love and devotion and burn not in mortal sins.
Again, they have obtained loving devotion, and they do not burn in the sense-objects, or (jare) they have not been entangled.
N7R5: Koorr = vain, false greeds. Dubidha = double-mindedness, the wandering of the mind. Sach = in the true Lord. Bhare = they remain fixed.
Their vain and false greeds come to an end, the wandering of their minds is removed, and they remain completely fixed in the ever-abiding Lord.
Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowing with Truth.
The falsehood had vanished love for duality has run away, and they are perfectly brimful with truth.
And from within the mind the vices such as falsehood have gone away, and the sense of duality has fled, and their inner selves are filled with the certainty of the perfect Parmesvar.
MGD0: Placing within their minds the one supreme light, the Lord, they remember him for ever.
They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.
They serve the Supreme Lord Master and place the unique One in their heart.
Placing Parbrahm the Lord, the One, within the mind, they serve him.
7TF8: Mah = months. Divas = days. Moorat = the auspicious moment. Jin kau = upon whom.

Those upon whom the Lord casts his glance of mercy (giving the gift of his own Name), for them all the months, all the days and all the auspicious moments are fortunate (the doubts and delusions about the holiness of the sangrand and the rest do not fall upon them).
The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace.
The months days and moments are auspicious for those on whom the Lord casts His merciful glance.
That one upon whom Waheguru casts his glance — to him the months and the moments are the highest.
XPCP: O Hari! Show mercy (upon me); I, Nanak, beg (at your door) for the gift of (your) sight. ||14||
Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy upon me! ||14||1||
Nanak asks for the boon of Yours sight, O God! Shower Yours benediction on Him.
Sri Guru ji says: O Parmesvar who makes all green! I beg for the gift of your sight; show mercy — the meaning being, grant the sight. ||14||1||
HZXE: Maajh, Fifth Mehl: Day And Night:
Majh Fifth Guru. Day and Night.
63NG: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the True Guru's favour He is obtained.
ZCS3: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.
I serve my True Guru and on God do I meditate the entire day and night.
266L: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.
Forsaking my self-conceit, I seek the Lord's refuge, and with my mouth I utter sweet words.
4SMF: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.
Since many births I am separated from you, O God! my friend and relation. Now, mercifully unite me with You.
GWGS: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.
The mortals who are separated from God they abide not in peace, O my sister!
4JV1: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.
Without God, the Spouse, solace is not obtained. I have searched and seen all the spheres.
SQ1S: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?
My own evil actions have kept me away from the Lord. Why should I accuse others?
94Y7: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.
Show mercy, O Lord! and save me. There is no other bestower of mercy.
SFGC: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. To whom should we utter our cries of distress?
Without You, O God! it is to role in dust. To whom shall I narrate my wail of distress?
5YJ0: This is Nanak's prayer: "May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being." ||1||
Nanak makes a supplication with my eyes "may I see God, the Angelic Person"
1L6V: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.
He, who is the omnipotent and infinite Lord God, listens to the inner anguish.
9B8B: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.
In death and life meditate on Him who is the mainstay of all.

9BY2: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.
In the world to come and in this world the bride belongs to the Spouse, who has a big family.
RS3S: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.
The Lord is lofty and inaccessible. His knowledge is unfathomable and there is no limit to His this and that end.
SAB6: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.
That service pleases Him which is rendered by becoming the dust of the feet of the saints.
V008: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.
The merciful luminous Lord is the Master of the poor and the saviour of sinners.
NZLE: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.
Since the very outset and beginning of ages the True Name of the Creator has been saving the mortals.
E0TA: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.
No one knows Master's worth nor is there any weigher of it.
4W91: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.
Nanak, he who is beyond reckoning, is dwelling within the mind and body.
