HM05: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||
I am ever a sacrifice to those who wait upon their Lord day and night.
Z03G: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.
The saints remember Him forever who is the pardoner of all,
D39A: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.
and who has created the soul and body and has mercifully granted us the very life.
JVNQ: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.
By the Guru's instruction meditate in the Lord and repeat the pure Name.
2GPX: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.
The worth of the Infinite Exalted Lord, cannot be described.
KKHM: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.
He in whose heart the Pervading God abides is said to be very fortunate.
MRPK: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.
By meeting Lord, the Spouse the mind's desires are fulfilled.
7ACK: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.
Nanak lives by remembering God and all his sins are effaced.
0SMX: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||
Day and night who forgets not God that being becomes ever green.
AU4Y: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.
The Lord is brimful with all the might. Of me dishonoured He is the resting place.
CUBX: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.
Within my mind I have grasped God's support and I live by repeating and remembering the Name.
NM9U: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.
Shower Yours benediction, O Lord that I may blend with the dust of Yours slave's feet.
S5B0: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.
As you keepest me so do I live. I wear and eat what you givest me.
27E4: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.
Grant me the enterprise, O Lord that I may sing Yours praises by meeting the saints.
RBES: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?
I can think of no other place. Where should I go to lodge a complaint.
79MB: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.
The lofty, unapproachable and immeasurable Lord is the destroyer of ignorance and the dispeller of darkness.
E1UQ: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.
Unite with You, O God! the separated soul. This alone is the object of Nanak.
Y6ME: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||
It shall be all-joy that day. O God! when I shall take to the Guru's feet.

Eulogy in Majh Measure and slok by First Guru. To be sung in the tune of Malik Murid and Chandarhara Sohia.
S6YQ: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:
There is but One God. True is His Name and creative His personality. By the Guru's favour He is obtained.

The Guru is the giver, the Guru is the house of ice and the Guru is the lamp (light) of the three worlds.
ZCST: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||
The Guru possesses the eternal wealth, O Nanak and by putting heart's faith in him peace is obtained.

In the tenth stage he is burnt and becomes ashes.
6VZ7: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.
His comrades accompany him to the pyre and give vent to loud lamentations.
B89P: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go.
The swan (soul!) flies away and inquires about the road to take.

QZHW: He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.
He came and departed and even his Name is dead.
4K58: After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.
After him food is offered on leaves and the crows are called.
FKPJ: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.
Nanak, the wayward love the spiritual darkness.
H7R1: Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2||
Without the Guru the world is drowned.
HXB5: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is called handsome.
At ten one is a child at twenty a youth and at thirty he is called handsome.
FJY8: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.
At forty he is full at fifty his foot falls back and at sixty old age comes on.
6Z8Z: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.
At seventy he loses his intellect and at eighty he cannot perform his duties.
